steps.text: When an acid meets a base, they cancel each other out. Let's watch it happen: Acid + Base → Salt + Water + Heat.
Tap “Mix” to combine the acid and the base.
Watch the results: salt and water form, a little heat is released, and the pH moves toward 7.
At the right proportions the solution becomes NEUTRAL (pH 7) — that's complete neutralisation.
This is how antacids work: a base neutralises excess stomach acid to relieve acidity.
